caption: The drawing depicts a central lidded tankard or stein rendered in detailed pencil shading, with ornate scrollwork and a lion motif engraved on its body. The tankard has a wide, flaring base, a domed lid with a decorative thumb lever, and an intricately patterned handle. Surrounding the main image are four smaller inset drawings: the upper left inset shows a circular monogram with entwined letters and leafy accents; the upper right inset presents a side view of the tankard’s handle and thumb lever; the lower left inset depicts a schematic frontal outline of the tankard; and the lower right inset displays a side profile of the entire tankard with measurements. The overall color scheme of the drawing is monochromatic, primarily utilizing various shades of gray pencil on a lightly toned background.
title: Silver Tankard
